title: eToro launches dedicated crypto staking service
description: eToro launched its dedicated staking service with Cardano and TRON, offering monthly staking rewards while eToro handled the staking process on users' behalf.
notes: The exact launch date is supported by eToro's first-party 1 October 2020 announcement. Statements that staked assets remain user property are retained as product language, not converted into a principal, segregation or insolvency guarantee.

title: Robinhood Crypto launches first staking product in Europe
description: Robinhood Crypto launched its first-ever crypto staking product for European customers, initially supporting Solana with flexible unstaking.
notes: The exact first-ever staking launch date is supported by Robinhood's first-party 15 May 2024 announcement. Later Ethereum and U.S. expansions do not change the original product launch date.
